concepts.title: What is Mathematics: The Search for Patterns

questions.q: Find the circumference of a circle of radius 28 cm (take pi = 22/7).
A circle has diameter 84 cm. Find its circumference (pi = 22/7).
Find the area of a circle of radius 84 cm (pi = 22/7).
Two concentric circles have radii 84 cm and 161 cm. Find the area of the ring between them (pi = 22/7).
Find the length of an arc that subtends 180 degrees at the centre of a circle of radius 63 cm (pi = 22/7).
Find the area of a sector with central angle 30 degrees in a circle of radius 21 cm (pi = 22/7).
Find the square of 27.
A square garden plot has each side 45 m. What is the number of square metres in its area?
How many non-square numbers lie between 6^2 and 7^2? (Rule: 2 x n)
Use the identity (a + 1)(a - 1) = a^2 - 1 to find 5 x 3.
What is the units digit of the square of 18?
A Pythagorean triplet starts with 2m = 26. Using the triplet (2m, m^2 - 1, m^2 + 1), find the largest member.
What is the 9th triangular number?
Find the triangular number formed by 7 dots arranged in rows of 1, 2, 3, ... dots.
What is the 6th hexagonal number? (Use the rule 3 x n x (n - 1) + 1)
A Koch snowflake starts from a triangle. How many sides does the figure have after 4 rounds of replacing the middle third of every segment? (Rule: sides = 3 x 4^(rounds - 1))
In the Sierpinski carpet, the middle square of every carpet is removed at each step. How many small squares remain after 4 steps? (Rule: remaining = 8^steps)
In the Sierpinski carpet, how many holes have been punched in total after 3 steps? (Rule: holes = (8^steps - 1) / 7)

concepts.title: Patterns in Shapes and Their Number Relations

questions.q: A set has 5 elements. How many elements are in its identity relation (a, a) for every element?
A set with 5 elements: how many pairs are in the full universal relation A x A?
How many pairs are in the empty relation on any set?
A reflexive relation on a set of 2 elements must contain at least how many pairs?
Set A = {6}. How many elements does the singleton set A have?
How many elements are in the empty set (its cardinality)?
